text:
PSYC 101: Introduction to Psychology — Fall 2026
Instructor: Dr. Amara Okoye | Office: Kline Hall 312 | Office hours: Tue 1:00-3:00 PM
Lectures: MWF 9:00-9:50 AM, Kline Hall 110

COURSE DESCRIPTION
This course surveys the scientific study of behavior and mental processes, including
research methods, biological bases of behavior, learning, memory, development, and
psychological disorders.

GRADING
| Component | Weight |
| Weekly quizzes (best 8 of 10) | 20% |
| Research participation | 5% |
| Response papers (3) | 15% |
| Midterm exam 1 | 15% |
| Midterm exam 2 | 15% |
| Final exam | 30% |

Late work loses 10% per day. Quizzes cannot be made up.
